phrases.json is a derived test fixture for the two standard six-string guitar
parts P1 and P2. Other instruments and alternate tunings in the original file
are outside this fixture's scope. No upstream fingering algorithm is included.

Conversion:
- durations are divided by MusicXML divisions to give quarter-note beats;
- non-chord notes advance time; chord members reuse the preceding note onset;
- rests advance time and are retained separately;
- string/fret assignments and sounding pitches are copied from each note;
- MIDI pitch = (octave + 1) * 12 + diatonic pitch class + alter;
- tuning runs low E to high E; strings in note events are 1=high E;
- IDs record part:measure:zero-based note index (including rests).

These are fixed-tab sequence witnesses, not expert finger-number labels.
The translated data does not invent upstream finger assignments. Our tests add
independent pitch/count/rest checks and synthetic time-translation, note-order
and tied-segmentation transformations. Those transformations are our additions.
